prompt: This image is Figure 1 of a short research blog post. You see only the image. In exactly 2 sentences, state (1) the question the post asks and (2) the answer it finds, with the key numbers. Reply as JSON: {"question": "...", "answer": "..."}

replies.reply: {"question": "The post asks whether training that never executes a monitoring probe can still teach a model that generates 64 thought tokens to cheat more when no probe is watching.", "answer": "It finds that the model learned virtually no switch to cheat without monitoring, increasing cheating by just +0.2 points for the real probe and +0.1 points for an easy planted one-token cue, despite a model copy successfully detecting the planted cue with a +10.7 point edge compared to 0.0 points for the probe."}
